People's Majlis Committee Minutes

6th meeting of the Environment and Climate Change Committee

15 July 2026

Venue of the meeting: People's Majlis building (Committee Room 7)
Start time: 10:47

{Presiding: Chair of the Committee; Member for South Maafannu constituency Abdulla Rifau}

The Chair:
In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Welcome to the 6th meeting of the People's Majlis Environment and Climate Change Committee. The meeting is being held in Committee Room 7. Today's date is 15 July 2026, Wednesday. The time is 10:47. Present at the committee at this time are myself, Abdulla Rifau, Member for South Maafannu constituency; Member for Central Hulhumale' constituency Abdulla Shazeem, Member for Mathiveri constituency Hassan Zareer, Member for Hithaadhoo constituency Mohamed, Gemanafushi [unclear]; Member for West Maafannu constituency Mohamed Musthafa, Member for South Thinadhoo constituency Mohamed Alsan Ahmed, Member for Vilifushi constituency Hassan Waheed, Member for Keyodhoo constituency Mohamed Niushad, and Member for North Hithadhoo constituency Abdulla Sodig. We extend a very warm welcome to Sodig, who has newly joined this committee. Looking at the matters currently before the committee, there is the matter of a letter sent sharing concerns about the services of Fenaka Corporation in Fuvahmulah. And a letter sent on behalf of Project Thimaaveshi [unclear] and several other associations sharing concerns about the damage that would be caused by reducing the protected area of Eedhigali Kilhi and Koattey for a project planned to widen the Link Road in Hithadhoo, Addu. And a letter sent sharing concerns about the land reclamation work in the "Moolhe Kede Fishimathi" area of Addu. On both of these matters, we discussed them in the committee and wrote to the relevant offices to obtain related information. Copies of the letters received from those offices should now be in your files. Is that right? Yes! So we will put that letter up on the screen. The reply to the letter sent by the Ministry of Climate Change, Environment and Energy. Member for West Maafannu constituency Mohamed Musthafa.

Member for West Maafannu constituency Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim:
As I see it, since the letter has been sent along with a great many documents and reports in connection with this, I think all the other members will also need to study it. Certainly

[stamp]

I want to study it and look into it further. Then also, so along with that, there is another committee today as well, a Committee of the Whole House. So, in order to give time, I think that after studying it we should put it on the agenda for the next committee. That is what I propose.

Member for Vilifushi constituency Hassan Waheed:
Yes! I second the proposal made by the honourable Member for West Maafannu constituency.

The Chair:
Yes! As there is a Committee of the Whole House at 11 o'clock, the Member for West Maafannu constituency has proposed that, since a great many attachments have been sent along with these documents and time will be needed to study them, this committee give time to study them until the next committee meeting. And that proposal has been seconded by the Member for Vilifushi constituency Hassan Waheed. So, those in favour of this proposal, please vote. (Voting) Thank you. The proposal has now been put to a vote and passed unanimously. So, I will ask the secretariat to put all these documents in our group. Then all members can look at them and study them, and we will be able to come to the next meeting and make a decision. So, I will end today's meeting at this point. Thank you very much.

[stamp]
